SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event e
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' 
AND e.event_id IN (
    SELECT link_to_event 
    FROM attendance 
    GROUP BY link_to_event 
    HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
)

SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.type, COUNT(a.link_to_member) as member_count
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
ORDER BY e.type
